monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The lighter guide now gives high-intent readers a reusable three-model evidence and first-year-cost comparison, then routes qualified choices into the neutral gear worksheet. No merchant, product, price, coupon, ranking, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: Both expanded pages use image-free records, tables, checklists, and primary-source cards; the technical change alters XML metadata only. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. The only supported position 4–20 non-brand content signal—Stem Cell CBG at 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2—was materially reinforced on October 15, so repeating that cluster today would risk cannibalization. No Data-led item was selected. One-impression queries, HTTP-variant noise, four ashtray impressions, two guide-hub impressions, and the Oklahoma page at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak, noisy, or outside the target range.

authority.action: Rebuilt the foundational label page into a citation-worthy cross-format field map and label-to-lot evidence card grounded in current New York OCM and FDA sources. Strengthened label, CoA, allergen, recall, claim-check, and official-source paths. The feed authorship gate adds a transparent machine-readable trust signal. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
